x: CENTRE LEFT: Alan Jackson wins Club 880 yards championship from John Thresher. CENTRE RIGHT: Clive Shippen leads at the water-jump in the "Brockman" steeplechase.

Trevor Tolson ran in the 100 yards, Dave Carter the 220, Alan Jackson and John Thresher the 880, and Clive Shippen the steeplechase. Peter Eldridge was one of two athletes to suffer at the hands of a poor starter in the 440 yards final, and although well down at the start still managed to finish 3rd.
Randy Glenn, Terry Newell and Alan Jackson produced a blanket finish for 2nd, 3rd and 4th, all recording 51.5. The hardest fought race of the day was the Senior 880 yards.

Of the "B" and "C" teams, Eric Penny and Fred Paget showed good form, and Alan Jackson's effort was most useful.
